title: Intaglio Etching
description: Un style d'illustration très détaillé, monochrome, imitant la gravure sur acier classique ou la taille-douce. L'image est entièrement construite par des réseaux complexes de ridules sombres et de hachures croisées sur un fond chaud semblable à du papier non texturé.
description_en: A highly detailed, monochromatic illustration style mimicking classical steel engraving or intaglio printmaking. The image is constructed entirely through intricate networks of fine, dark linework and cross-hatching against a warm, untextured paper-like background.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration très détaillé, monochrome, imitant la gravure sur acier classique ou la taille-douce. L'image est entièrement construite par des réseaux complexes de ridules sombres et de hachures croisées sur un fond chaud semblable à du papier non texturé.
prompt: Classical intaglio steel engraving illustration style. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Rendered entirely through a dense network of fine, {{primary_color}} linework and precise cross-hatching. The lines vary slightly in weight to suggest volume, shadow, and texture, but remain crisp and distinct, never blurring into solid washes. The background is a flat, untextured {{secondary_color}} tone, resembling aged vellum or warm parchment. Lighting and form are communicated solely through the density and directionality of the etched lines; closely spaced lines create deep shadows, while wider spacing and stippling indicate highlights and midtones. Edges are defined by the convergence of these lines rather than continuous outlines, giving a slightly jagged, organic feel to silhouettes. No gradients, no soft shading, no color variation beyond the {{primary_color}} ink on the {{secondary_color}} substrate. The composition is flat, relying on line density for depth cues. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. classical engraving, intaglio print, steel etching, fine linework, cross-hatching, monochromatic, {{primary_color}} ink, {{secondary_color}} paper, detailed line art, vintage botanical illustration style, crisp lines, hatching techniques, stippling, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame.

video.motion: Motion should be subtle and deliberate, resembling the slow reveal of a print being pulled from a press or gentle parallax layers of etched elements sliding past one another.
video.camera: Camera movements should be slow pans or zooms, maintaining the flat, 2D illustrative nature of the engraving.
video.temporal_texture: The cross-hatching and linework must remain absolutely stable and locked to the forms; lines should not boil, jitter, or redraw between frames.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth 3D rotations, motion blur, soft gradients blending, or boiling linework that breaks the illusion of a static etched print.
